causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q5JIZ3 sequence version 1 exactly equals BAD85880.1, 351 aa; PF01861 106-350 includes D159 and D160. PDB 6J26 has the full reference plus the 20-aa MGSSHHHHHHSSGLVPRGSH tag. Tested intact protein is not isolated-domain sufficiency.
causal_graphs.limitations: DIRECT describes net purified-preparation effects. Separate substrate assays are not a time-resolved single-molecule trajectory. Not-detected products are not proven absolute zero activity; numeric detection limits and matched folding controls are unavailable. No Asp159 covalent-carrier or proton-transfer step is asserted.

evidence.explanation: Primary Methods/Results and Figure 5 caption report both peptide masses and preparation chemistry. Independent isotope tracing, raw-spectrum reanalysis and donor-free comparison remain unverified.

edges.mechanism: The preparation yields a 2477.099-Da terminal species versus unmodified 2362.981 Da, consistent with two aminopropyl additions. This edge records the analytical product, not an exclusive atom-by-atom assignment.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q5JIZ3/BAD85880.1 terminal peptide 331-351 is GFEDEITVGQELYDDEESSTT; PF01861 is 106-350, so the peptide includes one extra-domain terminal residue. Five acidic-site labels in the paper conflict with this sequence; possible reference sites are E341/D344/D345/E346/E347.
causal_graphs.limitations: Observed mass-shifted species, not uniquely localized occupancy, demonstrated ester chemistry or productive carrier turnover. No donor-free MS comparison was established in the inspected text, so no quantified donor-dependent increase is claimed. Missing single-adduct and D159/D160 signals are detection-limited negatives. Raw spectra and original figure images were not independently inspected.

The Table 1 spermidine C9 efficiency disagrees with its kcat/Km arithmetic and is excluded. Norspermidine and N4-aminopropylspermidine are distinct acceptors, not synonyms of this assay substrate.

causal_graphs.limitations: The terminal mass shift is observed elsewhere; the proposed productive transfer, ester linkage, exact carrier pair and acid/base roles are not. The older D159 carrier assignment is not promoted into an observed edge. This hypothesis is not a family-wide mechanism.

causal_graphs.context: Anaerobic ASW-YT-S0 with 2 g/L elemental sulfur at 93 C; OD660 through 28 h, three independent experiments with SD. Supplement is 1 mM N4-bis(aminopropyl)spermidine. At 85 C the lag delay largely converges toward the parental final OD.

evidence.explanation: Figure 6B visually inspected alongside strain Table 1, disruption Methods and Results; baseline and supplementation must both be retained.

edges.mechanism: DBP1 lacks the parental increase in OD660 over the observed interval; this is strain-context evidence, not proof that every BpsA homolog is essential.
edges.subject: dbp1-versus-ku216-sulfur

evidence.explanation: Figure 6B dashed supplemented curve and caption explicitly specify 1 mM; no extrapolation to other polyamines or media.

edges.mechanism: Supplemented DBP1 shows delayed, lower OD recovery compared with KU216, but higher growth than unsupplemented DBP1. No complete rescue or uptake pathway is inferred.
edges.subject: add-bcpa-to-dbp1

causal_graphs.family_mapping: KOD1 TK1691 reference Q5JIZ3/BAD85880.1, PF01861 106-350. KU216 is delta-pyrF; DBP1 is delta-pdaD delta-bpsA::pdaD delta-pyrF, derived from DAD by pdaD insertion at bpsA. Whole-locus disruption is not a domain-specific lesion.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT genotype and supplementation effects; pdaD relocation is a confounder. Chemical rescue is partial, not bpsA genetic complementation or a measured transport mechanism. OD increase is not viability and cannot establish direct DNA, RNA or membrane stabilization.

evidence.explanation: Figure 5 squares versus triangles and circles; KPS construction and polyamine identity qualify the comparison.

edges.mechanism: KPS grows where DBP1 does not, although more slowly and to lower OD than KU216. This is alternative-pathway compensation, not same-gene rescue.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: BpsA-deficient locus maps to Q5JIZ3/BAD85880.1, PF01861 106-350. KPS is delta-bpsA::Pc-speE delta-pyrF, independently derived from KU216; DBP1 also carries the historical pdaD relocation. Pc-SpeE is a different enzyme, not restoration of PF01861.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT multi-genotype comparison. KPS accumulates thermospermine rather than restored branched polyamine. Its growth is slower/lower than KU216; partial compensation does not prove a unique molecular mediator. No matched DBP1 bpsA genetic rescue is supplied.

evidence.explanation: Figure 6A visually inspected with primary protocol and Results; misleading image alt text is excluded from interpretation.

edges.mechanism: DBP1 survival falls near zero after two cycles, whereas KU216 retains about 80% through four cycles. This is a relative CFU result, not an absolute count or quantified molecular damage rate.
edges.subject: dbp1-cold-genotype

evidence.explanation: Figure 6A squares/triangles/circles and Results; genotype backgrounds and normalization remain explicit.

edges.mechanism: KPS retains roughly 50% survival after two cycles compared with near-zero DBP1, but loses most survival after the third. This is conditional compensation, not full restoration or a claim that KPS outperforms KU216.
edges.subject: kps-cold-genotype

causal_graphs.family_mapping: BpsA Q5JIZ3/BAD85880.1 carries PF01861 106-350; DBP1 disrupts the whole locus with pdaD relocation, while separately constructed KPS replaces bpsA with Pc-speE. No isolated PF01861 perturbation or restored BpsA protein is tested.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT survival phenotype, not a direct membrane or DNA-protection assay. KPS protection is temporary and collapses after the third cycle. Supplementary raw CFUs/replicate details were not independently verified. Figure 6 accessibility text reverses the strain ordering; the inspected plot, legend and Results agree and take precedence.
